close_reason: fixed by PKIX-onc.9 fix (clone→move in TryFrom)
description: TryFrom<Certificate> for TrustAnchor takes cert by value but calls .clone() on subject and subject_public_key_info (lines 302-303). Since the impl consumes cert, these should be direct field moves: subject: cert.tbs_certificate.subject, subject_public_key_info: cert.tbs_certificate.subject_public_key_info. The clone is a copy-paste artefact from From<&Certificate>. Only try_find_cert_ext needs &cert so it must precede the struct literal, or be called via cert.tbs_certificate.extensions reference before consuming the fields.
title: TryFrom<Certificate>: needless .clone() on owned fields
